channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro atua para reduzir resistência entre mulheres
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro intensified efforts to reduce electoral resistance among women, attending an event with 200 female business leaders and opinion-makers where he reiterated his intention to select a woman as his running mate. He mentioned names such as Tereza Cristina, Simone Marquetto, and Clarissa Tércio, noting that the choice depends on an alliance between the União Brasil and PP federation. Despite emphasizing his commitment to defending women, the Genial/Quaest poll showed he has 24% voting intention among women, compared to 34% among men.

item.title: Flávio apresenta notícia-crime contra Lula por “ameaça”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) filed a criminal complaint with the Supreme Federal Court (STF) against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), accusing him of inciting homicide by strangulation against him. The claim stems from a statement made by Lula on April 2, which Bolsonaro interprets as a direct threat. The case was reported by the news outlet O Antagonista.

item.title: Flávio Dino toma posse como integrante substituto do TSE
item.description: Minister Flávio Dino was sworn in as a substitute member of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) on Thursday, June 11, in a formal ceremony at the office of TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques. His appointment, approved by the STF in May, follows the tradition of rotational succession based on judicial seniority. Dino joins Gilmar Mendes and Cristiano Zanin as STF-origin substitutes, while the other jurist substitute position remains vacant.

item.title: Acompanhe ao vivo a abertura da Copa do Mundo de 2026
item.description: The opening ceremony of the 2026 FIFA World Cup takes place this Thursday (June 11) at 2:30 p.m. Brasília time at Estadio Azteca, featuring performances by Shakira, Burna Boy, Belinda, Maná, J Balvin, and Tyla. Following the ceremony, Mexico and South Africa will kick off the tournament, reenacting their 2010 World Cup opener, which ended in a 1-1 draw. Attendees include UEFA President Aleksander Čeferin, Roberto Carlos, Ronaldo, and Luís Figo.

item.title: Senado usa pautas-bomba para constranger o governo
item.description: The Senate is advancing with 'bombshell' proposals totaling R$ 215 billion, aiming to pressure the Lula government in an election year by forcing vetoes that could alienate key voter segments. The opposition already has a narrative ready accusing the government of fiscal irresponsibility and increasing debt, using this move as a tool for political and fiscal manipulation. The article is subscriber-only.

item.title: Deputados governistas levam aos EUA defesa do Pix e cooperação contra facções, mas não se encontram com Republicanos
item.description: Brazilian ruling-party deputies traveled to the U.S. to advocate for the Pix payment system, seek U.S. cooperation against criminal factions, and raise allegations about ties between Bolsonaro’s family and Banco Master, but failed to secure meetings with Republican officials or the U.S. Department of Justice. They met only with Democratic lawmakers and OEA representatives, presenting documents on sovereignty, extradition requests related to the January 8 attacks, and financial investigations.

item.title: Eleição e briga de Alcolumbre com Lula explicam aprovação de 'pautas-bomba' no Senado
item.description: The Lula government suffered defeats in the Senate with the approval of 'budget-busting' measures, including a rural debt renegotiation that could create a R$140 billion fiscal impact. The administration attributes the loss to senators seeking electoral favors, Davi Alcolumbre's strategy to secure his Senate re-election, and the deteriorated relationship between Lula and Alcolumbre, marked by silence and no dialogue following the rejection of Jorge Messias for the STF.

item.title: Agência dos EUA confirma chegada do El Niño
item.description: The NOAA confirmed the arrival of El Niño in June 2026, with a 63% probability of reaching very strong levels between November 2026 and January 2027, potentially becoming one of the most intense since 1950. In Brazil, the phenomenon is expected to reduce rainfall in the North and Northeast while increasing it in the South, as the Lula government announced a R$ 2 billion environmental prevention package, despite budget cuts to rural insurance programs by the Ministry of Agriculture.

item.title: PT aproveita Copa e lança campanha 'Lula joga pelo Brasil' para reforçar defesa da soberania
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) launched on Thursday, June 11, 2026, the campaign 'Lula plays for Brazil', leveraging the opening of the FIFA World Cup to reinforce the narrative that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva defends national sovereignty amid threats of new tariffs from the Donald Trump-led U.S. government. The initiative aims to position Lula as a defender of Brazilian interests in a context of escalating international trade tensions.

item.title: AO VIVO: Abertura da Copa do Mundo; acompanhe
item.description: The 2026 World Cup opens live on Thursday, June 11, at 2:30 PM Brasília time at the Estadio Azteca in Mexico City, followed by Mexico vs. South Africa at 4:00 PM. Parallel opening ceremonies will take place in Toronto, Canada, and Los Angeles, USA, on Friday, June 12, with subsequent matches: Canada vs. Bosnia and Herzegovina and USA vs. Paraguay. Brazil debuts against Morocco on Saturday, June 13, at 7:00 PM in New York/New Jersey, aiming for a sixth title.

item.title: Azarão vira opção menos problemática para acabar com crise sobre chapa do PL no Rio
item.description: Carlos Portinho, the PL Senate leader, has emerged as the least problematic option for the party's Rio de Janeiro Senate slate amid internal disputes over candidate selection. Though seen as a longshot for not appealing to the radical electorate, his candidacy is viewed as strategic to avoid conflict between allies like Sóstenes Cavalcante and Carlos Jordy, and to spare Flávio Bolsonaro from having to choose between two Chamber allies. The decision may be delayed until just before the convention.

item.title: CNC chama presidenciáveis para defender agenda do comércio
item.description: The National Confederation of Commerce (CNC) has invited the four leading presidential candidates for an event on July 8 in Brasília to present its institutional agenda on commerce, services, and tourism. The agenda calls for tax and competitive parity between domestic firms and foreign platforms, stricter enforcement against piracy and smuggling, and a national AI program for micro and small businesses. The meeting serves as a pre-campaign sectoral economic hearing to gauge candidates’ willingness to adopt a platform combining national commerce protection, illegal market repression, and digital inclusion.

item.title: “Lula quieto é um grande poeta”, diz Coronel Assis
item.description: Deputy Coronel Assis (PL-MT), rapporteur of the PEC on reducing the age of criminal responsibility, strongly criticized President Lula during an interview on the Meio-Dia program in Brasília, stating that 'Quiet Lula is a great poet'. The comment came after Assis watched a video in which Lula mentioned the possibility of sending alerts to stolen cell phones.

item.title: Três meses depois, PEC do fim da reeleição para presidente é ‘esquecida’ no Senado
item.description: Three months after its introduction, the PEC seeking to end presidential reelection remains stalled, awaiting dispatch from Senate President Davi Alcolumbre. Led by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and backed by 29 lawmakers, the proposal received only 15 favorable votes out of 64 public opinions in the Senate system. The amendment would modify Article 14 of the Constitution to allow reelection only for state governors and mayors, excluding the president.

item.title: “As declarações desse presidente nos dão nojo”, diz relator da PEC da maioridade penal
item.description: Colonel Assis (PL-MT), rapporteur of the proposal to lower the age of criminal responsibility to 16 for serious crimes, harshly criticized President Lula during an interview on the Meio-Dia em Brasília program, stating that the president's remarks on public security and robbery make him feel 'disgusted'. The proposal was approved for admissibility by the CCJ of the Chamber last Wednesday, the 10th.

item.title: Lula chega à Copa em vantagem no placar, mas jogo eleitoral ‘só acaba quando termina’
item.description: Lula enters the World Cup with an electoral advantage, as a Quaest poll shows 47% approval and 48% disapproval, reversing a months-long negative trend. His main rival, Flávio Bolsonaro, faces pressure from leaked audios with Daniel Vorcaro and the inclusion of Pix in Trump’s tariff investigations, enabling the PT to launch slogans like 'O Pix é do Brasil' and jersey-inspired merchandise linking Lula to national patriotism.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula anuncia dados do desmatamento na Amazônia e no Cerrado
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva announced deforestation data for the Amazon and Cerrado at an OTCA event in Brasília, attended by Environment Minister João Paulo Capobianco and Science and Technology Minister Luciana Santos. The Deter and Prodes monitoring systems were presented to assess deforestation trends under his administration. The event underscores the government's commitment to environmental transparency and combating illegal deforestation.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro apoia Júlia Zanatta para vice na chapa de Flávio
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro endorsed federal deputy Júlia Zanatta (PL-SC) as vice-presidential candidate on Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL-RJ) 2026 ticket, praising her loyalty, congressional performance, and opposition to the left. Zanatta responded that 'the thing is taking shape,' signaling progress. Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS), former agriculture minister under Jair Bolsonaro, is also being considered, with Flávio saying her selection would be 'everyone’s dream.'

item.title: O número mais preocupante para Flávio Bolsonaro na nova Quaest não é o mais óbvio
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll shows that, although Flávio Bolsonaro remains Lula's main rival in 2026, his biggest concern is not the drop in voting intentions but the rise in rejection and loss of independent voters. Rejection reflects solidified negative perceptions, which are harder to reverse than temporary shifts in vote intention. Much of this wear is driving voters toward indecision or blank/null votes, with issues like the 'tariff shock' and his association with Donald Trump deepening discomfort among independents.

item.title: Lula, quatro anos depois e dez pontos a menos contra um Bolsonaro
item.description: According to the Genial/Quaest poll, Lula leads with 44% voting intentions against Flávio Bolsonaro, who has 38%, a six-point advantage. A month earlier, the two were technically tied, with 42% for Lula and 41% for the senator.

item.title: Lula faz comercial no horário nobre sobre bondades em ano eleitoral
item.description: The federal government aired a 1-minute commercial during prime time on open TV to highlight Lula’s social and labor programs, including debt renegotiation, Farmácia Popular, CNH Social, and the push to end the 6x1 work schedule. The ad links these initiatives to the slogan 'on the side of the Brazilian people' and was broadcast during high-audience news programs, with Lula also sharing it on social media.

item.title: Dr. Hiran critica desincompatibilização em eleição suplementar de Roraima
item.description: Senator Dr. Hiran (PP-RR) criticized judicial decisions requiring candidates to resign from office months before the Roraima supplementary election, arguing that ordinary election rules do not apply to a vote triggered by the cassation of the governor and vice-governor. He claimed that candidates like former Boa Vista mayor Arthur Henrique could not have anticipated the election and thus could not comply with disaffiliation timelines. Hiran accused Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino of improperly interfering in the electoral process and blocking the candidate's registration.

item.title: JOTA Principal: Indisposto com Lula, Alcolumbre maneja pauta do Senado contra planos do governo
item.description: Davi Alcolumbre, dissatisfied with the Lula government, has been delaying and modifying key Executive proposals in the Senate, such as the PEC to reduce the workweek to 6x1, despite lacking the power to block it entirely. He also advanced rural debt renegotiation projects and sought to overturn Lula’s Marco Civil da Internet decree, demonstrating efforts to hinder the government’s agenda in an election year.

item.title: Lula ocupa 6º lugar em ranking de aprovação na América Latina
item.description: According to CB Global Data's June survey, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva ranks 6th in approval ratings in Latin America with 47.6% approval, down 1.9 percentage points from May’s 49.5%. 48.1% of respondents evaluate his management negatively. El Salvador’s President Nayib Bukele leads the ranking with over 69% approval, driven by a 97% drop in homicides since 2018 due to his public security policies.

item.title: Crusoé: Como Putin influencia a política brasileira
item.description: The article claims that Vladimir Putin's dictatorship influences Brazilian politics through the Nova Resistência group and the purchase of Rádio Metropolitana 80,5 FM in Rio de Janeiro, suggesting Russian interference in public opinion and long-term social programs across Latin America. It links Putin to Lula in a photo but provides no direct evidence of his involvement in Brazilian affairs.

item.title: Poder da máquina faz diferença nas faixas médias e amplia o teto de Lula
item.description: The article argues that Lula’s governmental machinery is generating positive effects among middle-income voters and independents—key swing groups in the 2026 election. Policies such as Desenrola, income tax exemption for up to R$ 5,000, fuel price controls, and Move Brasil are improving perceived income and voter mood, boosting Lula’s voting potential among independents from 32% to 37% between March and June. This reflects the historical trend of incumbent candidates gaining strength as elections approach, particularly when popular measures directly impact voters’ finances.

item.title: Encontro entre Lula e Trump no G7 ainda não está confirmado, diz Lyrio
item.description: The meeting between President Lula and Donald Trump at the G7 Summit in France remains unconfirmed, according to Ambassador Mauricio Lyrio. While a conversation is possible, their schedules are still being reviewed and may not align. Lula’s participation in the G7 follows new U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods, which he considers a priority in bilateral talks.

item.title: Entre embate com Flávio Bolsonaro e memes, campanha de Lula vive disputa por influência no comando da estratégia digital
item.description: Lula’s 2026 campaign is experiencing an internal struggle over digital strategy: while Sidônio Palmeira, minister of Secom, advocates for an institutional and light approach focused on national pride and events like São João festivals, Nicole Briones and Ricardo Stuckert push for a more aggressive stance on social media, particularly in attacks against Flávio Bolsonaro, highlighting his ties to Daniel Vorcaro. Despite Sidônio’s influence, Lula’s personal Instagram account (14.7 million followers) will be managed by Briones and Stuckert, aligned with the PT’s goal to intensify digital confrontation.

item.title: Lula vai discutir valorização de países com terras-raras no G7
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will attend the G7 summit in France in June 2026 as a guest, focusing on the valorization of critical minerals, particularly rare earths, and balanced economic growth. Although Brazil is not a G7 member and will not participate in formal negotiations, Lula aims to endorse agreements aligned with Brazilian priorities, including international partnerships and child online protection, while avoiding discussions on U.S. tariffs and Middle East and Ukraine conflicts. The Brazilian delegation will only access final documents after approval by all G7 members.

item.title: O destino de Sidônio será definido em três semanas
item.description: Lula agreed with Sidônio Palmeira that, in the first week of July, the minister will decide whether to leave the government to fully dedicate himself to the electoral campaign or remain in the Palácio do Planalto until the first round of the election. The decision will be made within three weeks and will directly impact the PT's electoral strategy. The article is exclusive to subscribers.

item.title: Com uso da máquina, Lula dribla a oposição, e Flávio precisará de um ‘rebranding’
item.description: Lula reversed negative perceptions of his government by implementing popular but costly measures like fuel price cuts and the repeal of the 'blusinha' tax, regaining control of the national debate. Flávio Bolsonaro suffers from a damaged image tied to alleged corruption with banker Daniel Vorcaro and accusations of prompting U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods, requiring a rebranding effort to restore voter trust.

item.title: Ministra do TSE sinaliza análise rápida sobre ação de Flávio Bolsonaro contra pesquisa
item.description: Minister Estela Aranha of the TSE indicated she will conduct a rapid analysis before releasing the judgment on the AtlasIntel poll showing a drop for Flávio Bolsonaro, after requesting a view in Tuesday’s session. Kassio Nunes Marques’ decision to suspend the poll over alleged manipulation due to the display of a video of Bolsonaro’s conversation with banker Daniel Vorcaro was endorsed by the PL. The TSE is expected to resume the judgment following a meeting with polling institutes, scheduled for the coming days.

item.title: Prefeitura restringe acesso à lista de convidados ao camarote que recebeu Lula na Sapucaí
item.description: The Rio de Janeiro City Hall restricted access to the guest list for the municipal institutional box at Marquês de Sapucaí during the March samba school parades, which hosted President Lula and First Lady Janja da Silva. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Más notícias para Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: President Lula saw modest improvements in overall government approval and specific policies according to the Genial/Quaest poll, while Senator Flávio Bolsonaro faced negative evaluations of his actions, statements, and electoral strategy. His conversation with Daniel Vorcaro, funding of the film 'Dark Horse', and reliance on U.S. government support in his campaign were particularly criticized, with 47% agreeing with Lula that Bolsonaro sought new tariffs harmful to Brazilian businesses.

item.title: Flávio retrocede
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian election is being shaped by 'swing voters' — independent electors who shift their support based on perceptions of corruption and fears about party continuity or ascension to power. Currently, the prospect of Lula seeking a fourth term or Bolsonaro’s return via his son, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, is driving these volatile voter behaviors. The subscriber-only article emphasizes that these shifts are not ideological but pragmatic, driven by institutional anxieties and governance concerns.

item.title: GP Brasil, feira de vinil, festas para os solteiros: os eventos no Rio de Janeiro
item.description: Rio de Janeiro's event agenda from June 11–17 features the 2026 Brazilian Grand Prix, singles parties, vinyl fairs and cultural attractions. The GP Brasil 2026 celebrates the centenary of the Gávea Hippodrome with turf races, a gastronomic fair and children's activities. Other highlights include the Vinyl Fair with 60 exhibitors, the National Festival of Popular and Solidarity Economy at Píer Mauá, and musical events such as the talk between Zé Pedro and Joanna at Blue Note.

item.title: PT pede que STF e PF investiguem se houve 'caixa 2' para campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro no filme Dark Horse
item.description: The PT filed a request with the STF and PF to investigate alleged 'caixa 2' illicit financing in Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, claiming funds from the film 'Dark Horse' were used to support Eduardo Bolsonaro's political structure in the U.S. The party cites Intercept Brasil reports linking Flávio Bolsonaro to Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master and questions the use of parliamentary amendments, Ancine registrations, and foreign actors' work visas.

item.title: A conta no longo prazo: especialistas alertam para o impacto fiscal das ‘pautas-bomba’ aprovadas no Senado
item.description: The Senate approved three proposals labeled 'bombshell agendas' by the Lula government, despite Executive appeals to block them. The most impactful is the rural debt renegotiation, which advanced after senators and the economic team failed to reach an agreement. The measures carry billion-dollar costs and raise concerns about long-term fiscal impact.

item.title: O eleitor que tapa o nariz
item.description: The independent voter, exemplified by Seu Valdir, is decisive in the 2026 elections, rejecting both Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro due to distrust, not hatred. The anti-corruption banner lost its Bolsonarist appeal as voters perceive suspicion on both sides, while the defense of Brazil’s interests now favors Lula among independents. This volatile, distrust-driven vote prevents premature celebration by any campaign.

item.title: Peça-chave para outubro, eleitores 'independentes' ajudam Lula a recuperar vantagem sobre Flávio
item.description: Genial/Quaest poll shows President Lula regained lead over Senator Flávio Bolsonaro following scandals involving audio recordings in which the senator asked a banker for money to finance a film and new episodes linked to the United States. Lula opened a ten-point lead in the first round and six points in the second round. The survey was conducted after the audio leak and new controversies involving the senator.

item.title: Após ação do PSD, candidato do Novo ao governo do Rio nega uso de IA em locução e diz ter feito 'sátira política'
item.description: André Marinho, Novo party candidate for Rio governor, denied using AI in voiceovers of videos critical of Eduardo Paes, stating the voice is his own and the content is political satire. The PSD filed with TRE-RJ alleging illegal advance negative propaganda and electoral defamation, citing lack of AI disclosure as required by TSE. Marinho trusts electoral justice will distinguish satire from misconduct.

item.title: 10 pontos da Quaest, que mostra Lula ampliar vantagem sobre Flávio Bolsonaro após caso Master
item.description: The June Quaest poll shows President Lula extending his lead over Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to six points in a simulated runoff, with 44% to 38%. This shift follows the release of audio recordings involving Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro regarding funding for the film 'Dark Horse', which damaged the senator’s image. Among independent voters, Lula rose from 29% to 37%, while Flávio dropped from 31% to 24%.

item.title: Diplomatas apostam em encontro de Lula com Trump no G7 para evitar novas tarifas dos EUA contra o Brasil
item.description: The Brazilian government is betting on a meeting between Lula and Trump at the G7 in France to avert new U.S. tariffs, which Brasília views as politically driven and ignoring technical arguments already presented. Though not a G7 member, Lula was invited by host Macron, and diplomats believe a direct presidential meeting could break the technical negotiation deadlock at the USTR. Brazil has already responded with the Reciprocity Law, passed by Congress with government support, to retaliate against unilateral U.S. measures.

item.title: “Nós estamos preparados antecipadamente”, diz Lula sobre El Niño
item.description: President Lula stated that Brazil is proactively prepared to face the impacts of the upcoming El Niño, emphasizing preventive actions against wildfires and climate disasters. He announced an environmental package including R$2 billion for Ibama and ICMBio, creation of national parks, regulation of the National Environment Fund and the National Policy for Payment for Environmental Services, as well as the establishment of Sintrilhas and APBio.

item.title: Los presidentes Lula y Sheinbaum reafirman juntos su defensa de la no injerencia en plena presión de Trump en Colombia y Cuba
item.description: Presidents Lula and Sheinbaum reaffirmed in a videoconference their commitment to multilateralism, international law, democracy, and the principle of non-interference, amid external pressures. The meeting between the leaders of Latin America’s two largest economies underscored their joint defense of national sovereignty in a complex global context.

item.title: Kassio usa adiamento no TSE para tentar acordo sobre pesquisas e evitar desgaste por censura
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques aims to use the postponement of the ruling on the censorship of the Atlas/Bloomberg poll to negotiate an agreement with other justices and reduce the political fallout from the provisional decision that blocked the release of the survey showing a decline in Flávio Bolsonaro's support.

item.title: Ministro do TSE advoga para big tech no STF em ação sobre Marco Civil da Internet
item.description: TSE Minister Floriano de Azevedo Marques also acts as counsel for Google in the STF regarding the Marco Civil da Internet case, where the court expanded digital platforms' duties and responsibilities. This dual role raises concerns about potential conflicts of interest between his electoral authority duties and his legal advocacy for major tech firms.

item.title: PT pede a Dino que investigue financiamento de filme sobre Bolsonaro
item.description: The PT urged Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino to investigate the funding of the film 'Dark Horse', which portrays Jair Bolsonaro's political trajectory, citing evidence of possible misappropriation of parliamentary amendments and economic power abuse. The party alleges that Flávio Bolsonaro personally influenced the release of funds and links the project to pre-candidacies of other Bolsonaro family members, forming a 'benefited political group'.

item.title: Moraes autoriza visita de Flávio, netas e nora de Bolsonaro
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes authorized a visit for Jair Bolsonaro’s son Flávio Bolsonaro, daughter-in-law Fernanda Antunes Figueira Bolsonaro, and two minor granddaughters while the former president serves house arrest since March 24. The visit, scheduled for Saturday, 13, from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m., is deemed compatible with the purposes of house arrest, aiming to preserve essential family support during his sentence, with visitors subject to search and electronic devices held by police.

item.title: Conselhão recomenda que Lula encerre subsídios a combustíveis fósseis
item.description: The Economic and Social Development Council (Conselhão) recommended that President Lula phase out fossil fuel subsidies, redirecting saved resources toward clean energy and compensatory social policies. The proposal aims to correct price distortions, fiscal dependence, and delays in decarbonization, aligning with the global pathway developed for COP30. The report acknowledges resistance from fossil fuel-linked groups, advocating for a gradual and just transition.
